description:
Binding AI-law obligations that start applying soon, soonest first, with citation, official link and the guard
in one sentence.

When to use: someone asks what is coming, what to prepare for, or which AI laws take effect next year. For dates
already passed, use recently_in_force. Features and markets narrow the list (each left out covers everything);
within_days sets how far ahead to look. Each entry's guard is the change to make in the application (a notice, a
check, a human review step). Dates can change; returns at most 10, and `total` says how many there are.
Limits: informational data, not legal advice.

features.description: The AI feature's integration patterns, any of: chat, rag, agentic, decision_pipeline (a model output that decides about a person), content_generation, classification, recommendation, embeddings. Omit it for every pattern.
features.title: Features

jurisdictions.description: Markets to cover, as codes: EU, a country code (GB, CN, KR, JP, BR, SG) or a US state as US-XX (US-CA, US-CO, US-NY); US matches every state. Omit it for every market.
jurisdictions.title: Jurisdictions

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10 (default 10); `total` in the answer says how many matched.
limit.title: Limit

within_days.description: How many days after today to look, 1 to 730 (default 365).
within_days.title: Within Days

name: coming_into_force
title: AI law coming into force
